important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement (about 04 December 2026, 15 days from 19 November 2026)

qualification.details: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or the experience required. Candidates should check the official notification and the prescribing authorities for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay scales as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time

how_to_apply: Apply giving full particulars to the undersigned, the Chairman, Janata Education Society, Ajara, Dist.- Kolhapur, within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The advertisement is dated 19/11/2026, so the period ends about 04 December 2026 (15 days from 19 November 2026).
Reserved category candidates are advised to send a copy of their application to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur- 416004 (Room No. 138).
Incomplete applications will not be entertained.
The notice does not print an application form, a mode of dispatch or a fee.
important_instructions: This recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of the Hon. Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench, on write petition No. 12051/2015. The recruitment process will be carried out subject to the final outcome of cases currently pending in various courts regarding social and parallel reservations. Reserved category candidates from outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category. PWD, Woman, Orphans and Sports Person reservation will be applicable as per Government Resolution and Circulars issued from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Ajara Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 1 Principal and 5 Assistant Professor posts, one each in Economics, English, Marathi, Mathematics and Zoology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notice asks for applications within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement dated 19/11/2026, which is about 04 December 2026 (15 days from 19 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for the Ajara Mahavidyalaya posts?
faq.answer: Apply giving full particulars to the undersigned, the Chairman, Janata Education Society, Ajara, Dist.- Kolhapur. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q4. Which subjects are open for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor posts are open in Economics, English, Marathi, Mathematics and Zoology, one post in each subject.

faq.question: Q5. For how long is the Principal appointed?
faq.answer: The Principal is appointed for 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the attainment of the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q6. Is the Principal post reserved?
faq.answer: No category is reserved for it: the Principal post is open to all (1 post) and is treated as open category as per the High Court decision and the Regional Joint Director's letter cited in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. Should reserved category candidates send a copy of their application anywhere else?
faq.answer: Yes, they are advised to send a copy to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur- 416004 (Room No. 138).

faq.question: Q8. Which certificates must reserved category candidates produce?
faq.answer: They must produce the Caste Validity Certificate. Reserved category candidates other than SC/ST must also produce a Non-Creamy layer certificate at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q9. How are reserved category candidates from outside Maharashtra treated?
faq.answer: Reserved category candidates from outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category.
